summary: Leclerc hunts his first victory since Monaco while Antonelli edges closer to the championship, with the Ferrari driver setting the pace in practice as the Mercedes rookie prepares to clinch his maiden title in Austin. Verstappen's complaints about the circuit's treacherous bumps could reshape strategy and tire management across the field, potentially neutralizing Red Bull's usual setup advantages. A Leclerc win combined with an Antonelli points finish would mathematically seal the championship for the 22-year-old Mercedes driver and hand Ferrari a crucial morale boost before the season's final rounds.
